candidates.name: Tom Tiffany
candidates.bio: U.S. representative for Wisconsin's 7th District since 2020 and a former state senator.

source.title: guides.vote, 2026 Wisconsin governor voters guide: Tiffany cosponsored federal bills banning abortion once a heartbeat is detectable (H.R. 705, 2021; H.R. 175, 2023)
guides.vote, 2026 Wisconsin governor voters guide: Tiffany voted for Wisconsin's 20-week abortion limit (2015) and would uphold it
guides.vote, 2026 Wisconsin governor voters guide: Tiffany introduced a bill barring federal funding for solar and wind projects on farmland (H.R. 1754)
source.quote: Taxpayer dollars shouldn't be used to sacrifice farmland for green energy boondoggles.

source.title: guides.vote, 2026 Wisconsin governor voters guide: Tiffany introduced a bill directing the Interior Department to issue oil and gas drilling permits on public land (H.R. 9024, 2022)
guides.vote, 2026 Wisconsin governor voters guide: Tiffany voted to undo limits on seven hazardous air pollutants (2025), though he would set environmental standards for data centers
guides.vote, 2026 Wisconsin governor voters guide: Tiffany introduced a bill raising penalties for certain violent crimes and opposes commutations for violent criminals
guides.vote, 2026 Wisconsin governor voters guide: Tiffany would give police more tools and training
